skills.description: A skill for safe, coherent Airbnb operations in OpenClaw-style agent environments. It teaches a strict operating model: prefer Airbnb-native endpoints before generic browser automation; treat send acknowledgments as attempted, not automatically confirmed; verify outbound messages in the live thread UI before declaring success; and never auto-resend from ambiguous or unconfirmed state.
